PARTS

Level 0 is the auto split: the first level of the model tree that branches into several objects. Raise it to break parts down further. Click a name to select it, the eye to hide it.
Multi-select with ctrl+click. Merge fuses selected parts into one box-level part.

UP AXIS

DAE and glTF read the up axis from the file. Use these if an STL or OBJ comes in on its side.

Z GROUND

UNITS

Everything inside the app is inches. Change this only when a file came in the wrong size.

SNAP POINTS

Pick mode: click the model to drop a point on the selected part (or any part if nothing is selected). esc leaves pick mode. Snap points ride with their part.

USE ACTIVE POINT

JOINTS

A joint gives a part one keyable value: distance for a slide, degrees for a hinge. Axis runs from point A to point B (two snap points), or along a world axis through the pivot.

ACTIVE JOINT

A linked joint copies another joint's value times the factor, so one slider drives both ends of a beam.

JOINT PRESETS

RIDES WITH makes the chosen part follow the joint's part, for legs that travel with a sleeve.

EXPLODE / ASSEMBLE

Writes two keys per part: rest pose at the start time, exploded at the end. Toggle ASSEMBLE to run it the other way (exploded first, together at the end).

PATH

Moves the selected part through a chain of points. Turn on PLACE WAYPOINTS, then click snap points or the ground plane in order. Each click adds a key that puts the part's pivot on that point.

CAMERA

Orbit, pan and zoom the view, then KEY CAMERA to record it at the current time. The camera moves between its keys during playback and recording.
